session.title: Absorb Tuesday
session.purpose: Consolidate Tuesday's technical work and restore freshness for Thursday durability.

dose.completion: No planned bike, intervals, gym, or loaded strength session.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A true absorption day preserves technical learning and improves the quality of the second protected MTB exposure.
execution_rules: Normal daily movement is fine; do not convert recovery into a substitute workout.
If Tuesday was cancelled, do not automatically compress it into Wednesday.

expected_result.next_day: Normal legs, stable readiness, and no residual technical-processing or upper-body fatigue.

stop_rules: If unusual soreness, illness, or fatigue develops, retain recovery and downshift Thursday rather than chasing the week.
